notes: Raw model reports/logs stay in gitignored .tmp/. No real patient data or production Harness session was used.

Unknown output ceiling remains unknown. Accepted max_tokens is not proof of model capability.
Concurrent independent measurement processes share the selected provider. Latency is not a controlled throughput benchmark.
No 32k measurement: documentation failures are stream/time interruptions, not demonstrated 16k token exhaustion.
